_note: All landing page copy. Technical numbers (threshold, fees, supply, pairs) come from config.json / quotePairs.json, not from here. Layout is an editorial index: bracketed labels, numbered sections, mono metadata.

hero.body: Every Squeez token is born with a fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 and none of it goes to the dev. 100% sits on a bonding curve. When the curve fills, the token graduates itself to Uniswap v4 and its liquidity is locked forever.

route.label: Route
route.title: From first buy to locked liquidity.
route.body: A token has two homes in its life. It starts on the curve, where every buy pushes the price up. It ends in a Uniswap v4 pool that nobody can drain.
route.tagline: Two ends of the curve, one transaction.
route.curveCaption: Constant-product bonding curve, computed from config.json. X axis: HYPE raised. Y axis: price per token.

mechanism.label: Mechanism
mechanism.title: Four steps. No step to pull liquidity.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: SqueezLaunchFactory deploys the ERC-20 and its bonding curve, then mints the entire supply to the curve. The creator's opening buy is bundled into the same transaction.

steps.title: Bonding curve
steps.body: Buys and sells go straight to the curve, always in HYPE, whatever pair the creator picked. 5/7 of supply sells here.

steps.title: Graduation
steps.body: The buy that fills the curve triggers graduation on the spot. Excess HYPE is refunded. HYPE converts to the quote asset and a Uniswap v4 pool opens at the curve's last price.

steps.title: Locked
steps.body: Full-range LP and the remaining 4/49 of supply go to SqueezLiquidityLocker, a contract with no withdraw function. Nobody can pull it, Squeez included.

anatomy.label: Anatomy
anatomy.title: The token, taken apart.
anatomy.ariaLabel: 5/7 of supply sold on the curve, 10/49 becomes locked LP, 4/49 locked in the locker

fees.label: Fees
fees.title: Two numbers. Both locked per token.
fees.body: Applies on the bonding curve and after graduation through the Squeez hook on Uniswap v4. A 2% creator fee means traders pay 3% in total.
fees.destTitle: Creators choose where their fee goes

pairs.label: Pairs
pairs.title: Pair with HYPE, stablecoins, or tokenized stocks.
pairs.body: The curve is always in HYPE. The quote asset is used at graduation and for payouts after. Assets not yet confirmed on Elysium can't be selected.

protection.label: Protection
protection.title: 100 ms blocks. Protection counts seconds, not blocks.

items.title: Creator-only launch block
items.body: Only the creator can buy in the launch transaction.

items.title: Linearly decaying sniper tax
items.body: Buyers in the first seconds pay a tax that decays to zero.

items.title: Early max wallet
items.body: A per-wallet holding cap during the early window. Sells and transfers are not limited.

cta.label: Next
cta.title: Let's launch something.
cta.body: Elysium mainnet goes live November 9, 2026. Testnet is already running. Grab testnet HYPE from the faucet and try a launch now.
